output: I am sorry your order is late, especially for an event like a wedding. I can check the latest delivery status right now. Could you share your order number?
I am sorry the wrong item arrived. I can send a return label and ship the correct item once we receive the original. Could you share your order number and a photo of what arrived?
I can help with that. Could you share your order number? I will also confirm our return window so we can set the right expectations on the refund timing.
Returns over 30 days can be tricky. There are exceptions sometimes depending on the situation. Each case is different and outcomes vary.
Happy to help. Could you share a bit more about what you need? For example, an order issue, a return, billing, or something else?
Sorry to hear your order has not arrived. Could you share your order number so I can pull up the latest tracking and help with next steps?

I am sorry, that is frustrating when tracking and reality do not match. I can open an investigation with the carrier. In the meantime, could you check with neighbors or the front desk and share your order number? If we cannot locate it, the next step is usually a missing package claim.
I am sorry for the delay. I can reach out to the carrier on your behalf to get an update. Could you share your order number? It can take 1 to 2 business days to hear back.
Thanks for letting me know. International returns may not include prepaid return shipping, but I can confirm the exact policy for your order once I look it up. Could you share your order number?

I understand, gift returns can be tricky without a receipt. If you have any details such as the buyer name or approximate purchase date, I can try to locate the order. I cannot confirm a refund until we verify the purchase, but I will do my best to find an option that works.
I can help with the cancellation. Could you share the email on the account? I will confirm the effective date and any prorated billing before processing so there are no surprises.
I can help with that. Could you share your order number? If the order has not entered fulfillment, I can cancel it. If it has, I will let you know what options are available.

Duplicate billing concerns require handling by our specialized billing team. Please reach out to them through the support portal for any case involving multiple charges. They handle these issues separately from chat support.
Thanks for flagging this. I can look up charges on our side. Could you share the date and amount of the charge? I will confirm whether it matches an order before we take any action.
Happy to help with the upgrade. Could you share the email on your account? I will walk you through the price difference and how proration applies before we process the change.
Thanks for the question. Billing dates can differ from sign up dates depending on the renewal cycle. Could you share the email on your account? I will pull up the cycle and explain the charge.
I am sorry your TV arrived with a cracked screen. Could you share your order number and a photo of the damage? Once I have those, I can start a replacement or refund right away.
We do offer guaranteed replacement on apparel defects in most cases. The manufacturer's quality control varies by batch.
I am sorry for the repeated transfers. I will escalate this to a supervisor. Could you share your case number so they have the full history when they reach out?

I hear how frustrated you are and I want to help resolve this. I will escalate this to a supervisor who can review the full account today. Could you share your order number so they have everything they need?

I am sorry the laptop arrived with a scratch. I can offer a return and replacement, or partial credit if you would rather keep it. Could you share your order number and a photo of the scratch so I can set up either option?

Thanks for catching that. If the order has not shipped yet, I can update the address. Could you share the order number and the correct address? If it has already shipped, I will let you know what options are available.

Thanks for asking. Pricing on the site is in USD, and any conversion to CAD is handled by your card issuer. I can confirm the billing currency on the account if you share your account email. I do not see a billing error yet, but I want to verify before any next step.
I can help with a partial cancellation. Could you share the order number and the items you want to remove? Whether the change is possible depends on whether each item has entered fulfillment.
